channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fará campanha com colete à prova de balas, diz líder do PL
item.description: The leader of the PL party in the Chamber of Deputies, Sóstenes Cavalcante, stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s presidential candidate for 2026, will conduct his entire campaign wearing a bulletproof vest. The remark highlights the heightened climate of tension and insecurity in Brazilian politics, particularly among right-wing figures.

item.title: Michelle: “Vamos eleger Flávio Bolsonaro presidente”
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL), running for Senate in the Federal District, urged voters to support Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), the presidential candidate, during campaign events in Brasília and Ceilândia. She appeared alongside Governor Celina Leão (PP), who is running for re-election, and advocated for Flávio Bolsonaro to become Brazil's next president.

item.title: Lulistas cobram governo por concessão de prédio histórico no Rio
item.description: Supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva are demanding the federal government grant concession of the Casarão Cândido Mendes building in Rio de Janeiro’s Santa Teresa neighborhood, currently occupied by 64 families since 1997. Although the property was approved for the Minha Casa, Minha Vida – Entidades program in June 2026, the concession has not been granted, blocking renovation and social work efforts. The activists sold custom shirts during Lula’s re-election campaign launch in São Bernardo do Campo, urging the president to intervene directly.

item.title: Tarcísio inicia campanha em Osasco com presença de 14 prefeitos e lideranças partidárias
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) launched his re-election campaign in Osasco, an event that also served as the launch for Rogério Lins (Podemos) as a state deputy candidate. The gathering featured 14 mayors, including São Paulo's Ricardo Nunes (MDB), and leaders from 10 allied parties, showcasing political strength. Tarcísio promised local improvements such as a Fire Department, integration with Poupatempo, a Bom Prato meal program, progress on Metro Line 22, and a specialized medical outpatient clinic in Osasco.

item.title: Vila Euclides fica com espaços vazios na largada de Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva officially launched his 2026 re-election campaign at the Estádio Municipal 1º de Maio in São Bernardo do Campo, the historic Vila Euclides site. Despite the venue's significance as a labor movement stronghold, aerial footage revealed under-attendance, with empty sections caused by large banners and obstructed views behind the stage.

item.title: Lula dá pontapé inicial na campanha usando as cores do Brasil e falando em soberania nacional
item.description: President Lula kicked off his re-election campaign at an event in the Vila Euclides Stadium in São Bernardo do Campo, emphasizing national sovereignty, public safety, women's protection, rare earth exploration, education valorization, and the need to elect workers' representatives over business owners. The event featured the Brazilian flag, a rendition of the national anthem by Fafá de Belém, and green and yellow fireworks. Lula blamed the Bolsonaro government for pandemic deaths, denounced organized crime operating from affluent areas, and called for constitutional changes to strengthen security and education, framing his vision as a class-based struggle against elite interests.

item.title: Lula discursa em primeiro dia de campanha; veja principais frases
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) delivered his first campaign speech for the 2026 election in São Bernardo do Campo (SP), criticizing the right and proposing policies on public security, full-time education, and critical mineral exploration. The speech took place in the city where Lula began his political career in the 1970s union movement, marking the official start of the campaign, which now allows explicit vote requests, rallies, and online advertising. TV and radio advertising will only be permitted starting August 28.

item.title: Em 1º ato, Lula ataca a direita, defende terras raras e fala em eleger maioria no Congresso
item.description: In his first campaign act at Vila Euclides Stadium in São Bernardo do Campo, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) attacked the right, accusing it of responsibility for 400,000 COVID deaths and mocking children lacking medicine. He defended Brazil’s exploration of rare earth minerals and stressed the need to elect a favorable majority in Congress to advance his agenda. The event marked the launch of his 2026 re-election campaign, highlighting his union roots and vowing to keep fighting as long as he lives.

item.title: Janja: “Antes de casar com um Silva, eu já era uma Silva”
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva stated she already bore the Silva surname before marrying President Lula, using her personal story to advocate for women's participation in politics and society. She emphasized that women hold multiple roles and that individual progress lifts all women, noting the PT's increased inclusion of women in the campaign launch after a national convention oversight. Janja also publicly mentioned Lula's former wife, Marisa Letícia, for the first time, crediting her with embroidering the PT's first flag.

item.title: Vitória x Botafogo no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Vitória and Botafogo face off this Sunday, August 16, at 6:30 PM Brasília time, at Barradão, in the 23rd round of the Brasileirão. Vitória sits 13th with 26 points, while Botafogo is ninth with 30 points despite a 6-1 loss to Cienciano in the Copa Sudamericana. The match will be exclusively broadcast on Premiere, with probable lineups already released.

item.title: Sem Kassab, Caiado lança campanha em carreata e diz que fala sobre Centrão foi mal interpretada
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado launched his electoral campaign with a motorcade in Águas Lindas de Goiás, without the presence of his running mate, Gilberto Kassab, who did not attend the event. Caiado stated that his remarks about the Centrão were misinterpreted, seeking to clarify potential political misunderstandings.

item.title: Tarcísio relembra vitória na abertura da campanha e diz: 'Osasco precisa de mais atenção'
item.description: Governor of São Paulo Tarcísio de Freitas launched his re-election campaign in Osasco, in the metropolitan region, recalling his 2022 victory and stating that the city needs more attention. He used the occasion to reinforce his initial legacy and signal priorities for a potential second term.

item.title: Centrão abandona Flávio e deixa PL com palanque esquálido no RJ e em MG
item.description: The Centrão is withdrawing regional alliances with the PL, leaving Flávio Bolsonaro with a weakened political base in Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais. According to analysis by Thais Bilenky and José Roberto de Toledo in A Hora, on UOL Canal, this fragmentation diminishes the candidate’s electoral prospects in key states for the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Caiado: 'Os Estados Unidos não mandam no Brasil; eleição nossa é no Brasil'
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that the United States does not dictate Brazil's affairs and that the Brazilian election will be decided solely within the country, in response to questions about U.S.-Brazil relations.

item.title: Pazuello acena ao eleitorado feminino em primeiro ato da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Former Health Minister Eduardo Pazuello (PL) opened the campaign launch event for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential race with an appeal to female voters, emphasizing health and family well-being. The event marked the official start of Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy, son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, backed by key figures of the bolsonarist movement.

item.title: Lula reencontra metalúrgicos do ABC no lançamento de sua campanha
item.description: Lula launched his 2026 re-election campaign at Estádio 1º de Maio in São Bernardo do Campo, reuniting with ABC metalworkers and recalling his union leadership in the 1970s and 1980s. The event emphasized the history of labor strikes, the fight for democracy during the dictatorship, and the PT’s roots in social and union movements, reinforcing ties to the party’s historical base.

item.title: Advogado de Heleno desiste de candidatura após denúncia de violência doméstica
item.description: Lawyer Matheus Mayer Milanez, former federal deputy candidate for the Republicans in the Federal District, withdrew his candidacy after a protective measure was granted by the court to his ex-fiancée, who is 10 weeks pregnant and accuses him of domestic violence. The withdrawal was filed with the TSE on Friday, the 14th, two days after the court's decision.

item.title: Marina diz que não é justo oposição voltar para destruir Amazônia
item.description: Marina Silva (Rede), Senate candidate for São Paulo, stated during Lula’s re-election campaign launch that it is unfair for the opposition to return to power to destroy the Amazon and reverse social progress. She advocated for job creation, protection of women, children, and youth, and emphasized democracy and national sovereignty. Simone Tebet was also named as a Senate candidate for São Paulo, supporting the election of both women to the two available seats.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio minimizam público reduzido no ato em Copacabana
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro downplayed the low turnout at his presidential campaign kickoff in Copacabana, stating it was a political rally, not a mass demonstration, and that no buses were needed to mobilize supporters. They also justified the absence of national PL leaders such as Michelle Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Nikolas Ferreira, arguing that Tarcísio’s absence from the Rio event would be 'bad' for his re-election bid in São Paulo in 2026.

item.title: Antes de ato em SP, Lula fez sessão de radioterapia para tratar câncer de pele
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held his first campaign rally in São Bernardo do Campo (SP), revealing he had undergone a radiotherapy session to treat scalp skin cancer before the event. He explained the treatment followed the removal of a basal cell carcinoma lesion in April and that he must avoid sun exposure on his head. The rally marked the official launch of the Lula-Alckmin ticket, backed by seven parties, and took place at the site where he began his political career as a metalworker.

item.title: Pablo Marçal declara 7 bilhões em bens à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Pablo Marçal declared to the Electoral Justice assets worth 7.4 billion reais, a 4,276% increase from the 169.5 million reais he declared in 2024, potentially making him the wealthiest presidential candidate in Brazilian history. His candidacy was filed at the deadline following an injunction allowing his party switch from União Brasil to PRTB, though he remains ineligible until 2032 due to convictions for economic power abuse in the 2024 election.

item.title: Michelle pede votos para Flávio e diz que "logo" Bolsonaro voltará
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro urges support for Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running for president, and says Jair Bolsonaro 'will soon' return. The event took place in Ceilândia, Federal District, alongside Governor Celina Leão, emphasizing the unity of the ticket and describing her Senate campaign as a mission entrusted by the former president.

item.title: Michelle e Malafaia não comparecem a ato de Flávio, em Copacabana
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro and pastor Silas Malafaia did not attend the launch event for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign in Copacabana, although allies claim past tensions have been resolved. Michelle, a Senate candidate for the Federal District, was focused on her own campaign and had recorded election ads with Flávio. Malafaia, a supporter of Tarcísio de Freitas, said he does not participate in partisan political acts and sent only an audio message.

item.title: Janja homenageia Marisa Letícia em 1º ato de campanha de Lula
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva paid tribute to Marisa Letícia, Lula’s former wife, during the first campaign event for the president’s re-election bid in São Bernardo do Campo on Sunday, the 16th. The tribute underscored Marisa Letícia’s historical significance as part of the launch of Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Janja cita Marisa, que foi mulher de Lula, pela 1ª vez em discurso
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva mentioned Marisa Letícia, Lula's second wife, for the first time in a public speech during the launch of the president's re-election campaign in São Bernardo do Campo. She emphasized Marisa's essential role alongside other women in the behind-the-scenes support of 1970s labor movements, including sewing the first PT flag, and criticized the historical erasure of such female contributions. The reference marks a shift from Lula's prior pattern of avoiding public mentions of Marisa since her death in 2017.

item.title: MPF investiga anúncio de repasse milionário do governo Lula para obra parada na Bahia
item.description: The Federal Public Prosecutor's Office in Bahia has opened an inquiry to investigate a 35 million reais transfer announced by President Lula for the resumption of the stalled Polytechnic School construction at UFBA, which has been halted since 2016. The announcement was made during Lula’s agenda in Salvador in the first half of 2024, and the probe aims to assess potential irregularities in the funding from the New PAC Universities program. The initiative is opposed by the academic community, which advocates for upgrading existing infrastructure rather than expanding it.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro está entusiasmada com a campanha ao Senado, dizem aliados
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is enthusiastic about her Senate campaign in the Federal District after overcoming a period of uncertainty and threats to leave the PL party. Her public reconciliation with Flávio Bolsonaro, marked by a meeting and joint video recordings, was described by allies as a 'happy ending'. She is being welcomed as a major political star by PL Senate candidates, who are competing for her attention and endorsement.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro inicia corrida à Presidência em Copacabana
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) officially launched his presidential campaign in Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, on Sunday (August 16), leveraging symbols and political references from his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The event featured his wife Fernanda, vice-presidential candidate Alfredo Gaspar (PL), and Rio gubernatorial candidate Douglas Ruas (PL), alongside allies such as Sóstenes Cavalcante and Valdemar Costa Neto.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lança campanha com colete a prova de balas e bandeira dos EUA entre manifestantes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro launched his presidential campaign in Copacabana, wearing a bulletproof vest and accompanied by allies including Fernanda, Douglas Ruas, Daniella Marques, and Alfredo Gaspar. The event took place on a sound truck along Avenida Atlântica, featuring speeches that appealed to female voters, referenced former President Jair Bolsonaro, chanted 'Return, Bolsonaro,' and attacked transgender rights, while demonstrators raised a U.S. flag.

item.title: ‘Toda a direita vai estar unida no segundo turno’, diz Romeu Zema no primeiro dia de campanha
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo Party's presidential candidate, launched his campaign in Montes Claros (MG), emphasizing his record in attracting investments and criticizing Lula's foreign policy, particularly its treatment of the U.S. and alignment with non-democratic regimes. He asserted that the entire right will be united in the second round, drawing a parallel to Chile's recent elections, and pledged to support any right-wing candidate opposing the PT in that scenario.

item.title: Janja acena aos evangélicos e faz “playback” com jingle gospel em ato do PT
item.description: First Lady Janja made an overture to evangelical voters during the launch of President Lula's re-election campaign in São Bernardo do Campo. After discussing women's issues and honoring former First Lady Marisa Letícia, she surprised the audience by inviting gospel singer Cleber Lucas on stage, where a video played showing her singing along to the campaign's jingle 'Tapete Vermelho'.

item.title: Caiado dá início à campanha e diz ser o único capaz de derrotar Lula
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) launched his presidential campaign on March 16, claiming he is the only candidate capable of defeating Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a runoff. He criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and the Lula government, stating the PL is 'panicked' by his candidacy. Caiado positioned himself as a viable alternative to defeat the incumbent president, emphasizing his experience as former governor of Goiás.

item.title: Caiado começa campanha eleitoral com carreata no Entorno do DF e diz que, se eleito, agirá com 'garra' e 'determinação'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD candidate for President, officially launched his electoral campaign with a motorcade in the Federal District's surrounding area, starting in Águas Lindas de Goiás. After attending a mass, he stated that if elected, he would govern with 'grit' and 'determination', citing national challenges and using his record as governor of Goiás as the foundation for his federal proposals. He emphasized achievements in public security, health, education, and social programs, and said he will travel across the country over the next 49 days to present his candidacy and platform.

item.title: Janja homenageia Marisa e reforça apoio feminino a Lula: "Admiração"
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva paid tribute to former First Lady Marisa Letícia, a PT symbol, during the launch of President Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign in São Bernardo do Campo. She praised Marisa’s legacy, noting she embroidered the PT’s first flag, and emphasized the importance of female support for Lula’s victory. The event marked Lula’s return to the site where his political journey began, under the slogan 'It’s where it all began. And where a new journey will start'.

item.title: Janja lança jingle de Lula, em que canta com pastor, e ‘encarna’ Tim Maia
item.description: First Lady Rosângela da Silva, known as Janja, launched the official re-election campaign jingle for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at an event in São Bernardo do Campo (SP), singing alongside evangelical pastor Kleber Lucas. The jingle aims to appeal to women and evangelical voters, key demographics in the electorate. Janja also paid tribute to Lula’s former wife, Marisa Letícia, and jokingly referenced Tim Maia after experiencing audio delays during her speech.

item.title: Romeu Zema começa campanha à Presidência com missa e caminhada em Montes Claros
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) officially launched his presidential campaign in Montes Claros, Minas Gerais, attending a mass at the Nossa Senhora da Conceição e São José Parish followed by a walk through the city’s central streets. He was accompanied by federal deputy candidate Marcus Vinicius (Novo) and the latter’s wife. By starting the campaign in the Minas Gerais interior rather than Belo Horizonte, Zema emphasizes his strategy to expand the Novo party’s state-level political project — built during his two terms as governor since 2019 — to the national stage.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro inicia campanha à Presidência no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) officially launched his presidential campaign on Sunday (16) in Rio de Janeiro, holding a rally at Copacabana Beach. He was joined by his running mate Alfredo Gaspar, gubernatorial candidate Douglas Ruas, as well as his mother Rogéria and wife Fernanda. Starting this Sunday, candidates are permitted to explicitly ask for votes and conduct campaign activities, in accordance with TSE regulations.

item.title: Após crítica de Lula por falta de mulheres, Benedita da Silva e Janja abrem discursos da campanha
item.description: Following Lula's criticism about the lack of women speakers at a PT event, First Lady Janja and Senate candidate Benedita da Silva delivered the inaugural speeches of Lula's re-election campaign in São Bernardo do Campo. Benedita advocated for more women in Congress and spoke on behalf of government-aligned female candidates, while Janja honored Marisa Letícia, emphasized women's majority in the population and electorate, and called for a president who cares for women, not just one who expects them to be caregivers.

item.title: Manifestantes protestam contra Tarcísio na porta de clube do Sindicato dos Metalúrgicos de Osasco
item.description: Protesters demonstrated against Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and state deputy candidate Rogério Lins at the entrance of the Metalworkers' Union club in Osasco. The protest occurred during the launch of Lins' candidacy, with accusations of betrayal toward peripheral communities and criticism of violence in São Paulo. Demonstrators claimed the alliance between Lins and Tarcísio symbolizes the abandonment of favelas and working-class neighborhoods.

item.title: Antes de anúncio, JHC fez chegar a Lula que seria candidato ao governo
item.description: Former Maceió mayor JHC informed President Lula of his decision to run for governor of Alagoas instead of the Senate, following pressure from allies and the PSDB/Cidadania leadership, including Arthur Lira. The shift surprised allies like Ronaldo Lessa and forced Renan Filho to delay his running mate announcement, selecting Yale Fernandes as vice. JHC’s maneuvering included securing Celia Rocha as his running mate on the PSDB ticket, overturning prior expectations.

item.title: “Lula e Flávio não são alternativas”, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Mission Party, launched his presidential campaign on March 16, attacking Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) as corrupt and claiming to be the only one capable of confronting them. In a social media video, he positioned himself as the sole alternative to what he called 'Lula's corruption and corruption...'.

item.title: Lula usa helicóptero para ir a lançamento de campanha em SP
item.description: President Lula arrived by helicopter at a campaign event in São Bernardo do Campo (SP) on Sunday, August 16, accompanied by First Lady Janja, who filmed the arrival. The use of the FAB aircraft is permitted for security reasons, with costs to be reimbursed by the party. In addition to this event, Lula has campaign stops scheduled in Belo Horizonte (August 21) and Rio de Janeiro (August 22).

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio após números da semana
item.description: Recent polls show the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tightening, with Quaest and BTG/Nexus indicating a technical tie in a potential runoff, while CNT/MDA still shows Lula ahead but with a reduced lead. In the first round, Lula leads all surveys with advantages ranging from 5 to 13.7 points, and other candidates remain far behind.

item.title: Caiado inicia campanha em Goiás com críticas ao PL e diz ser o único capaz de derrotar Lula: ‘Eles estão desesperados’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate, launched his campaign in Goiás by criticizing the PL and Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming he is the only one capable of defeating Lula in a runoff. He proclaimed himself 'clean-handed,' citing no involvement in scandals like Master, and highlighted his 87% approval as governor despite only 4% in voting intentions. Caiado called the PL 'desperate' and panicked, emphasizing he is the only Brazilian politician with a mandate who never voted for Lula and opposes the PT.

item.title: Caiado faz carreata sem Kassab e diz que fala sobre Centrão estar com Lula foi mal interpretada
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado launched his campaign caravan in Águas Lindas de Goiás without his running mate Gilberto Kassab, who was coordinating the event in São Paulo. Caiado claimed Kassab’s statement that the Centrão supports Lula was misinterpreted, reaffirming his opposition to the PT and stating he is the only incumbent who never voted for Lula. He said his campaign aims to remove the PT from power and that he has the courage, competence, and credentials to defeat Lula in a runoff.

item.title: TSE impede análise de liminar que mandava PT entregar documentos sobre congresso e canal ligado a Lula
item.description: The TSE blocked the analysis of a provisional order by Minister André Mendonça that had required the PT to submit documents regarding its 8th National Congress and the 'Canal Porta Vozes do Lula', ruling that the case had been improperly distributed. By a 5-2 vote, the Court decided to redistribute the case as a Precautionary Action among competent ministers, nullifying the referral of Mendonça’s decision. The order sought to investigate alleged misuse of party funds to produce content against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, though Mendonça had noted insufficient evidence of illegality at the time.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio Bolsonaro faz 1º ato de campanha em Copacabana
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) launched his presidential campaign with the first act in Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, on Sunday (Aug. 16, 2026). Supporters gathered at 10 a.m. at Posto 5, chosen as his hometown and the Bolsonaro family’s electoral stronghold. The senator was joined by allies, including state deputy Douglas Ruas (PL), candidate for governor of Rio, on the sound truck.

item.title: Lula faz primeiro evento de campanha à reeleição no berço político do PT, em São Paulo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva officially launched his re-election campaign in São Bernardo do Campo, the PT’s political birthplace, alongside Fernando Haddad and Geraldo Alckmin. The event marks the start of permitted electoral activities, including rallies and online propaganda, while TV and radio ads begin only on August 28. Other leading candidates also launched campaigns in key regions, except Ronaldo Caiado.

item.title: Tarcísio inicia campanha com discurso voltado às mulheres
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) launched his re-election campaign for São Paulo governor in an event in Osasco, delivering a speech focused on women. Unlike in 2022, when he campaigned alongside Jair Bolsonaro, this time he did not have the presence of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), the Bolsonarist presidential candidate. The event signaled a strategic shift in political messaging, aiming to broaden appeal among female voters.

item.title: Simone Tebet alfineta bolsonaristas em evento com Lula: ‘Gritam Barrabás’
item.description: Simone Tebet criticized Bolsonarists during an event with Lula in São Bernardo do Campo, accusing them of shouting 'Barrabás' when speaking of Christ and defending only 'their own family'. She claimed the progressive camp truly defends family values. The event marked the official start of the 2026 election campaign, with expectations of 20,000 attendees at Vila Euclides Stadium.
